purpose: Bind global render/quality policy and active renderer texture residency to the exact realtime-reflection and native-4K evidence epoch. This prevents a legal scene/material/light state from being rendered with a different Built-in graphics tier, quality profile, render pipeline, texture mip limit or camera-dependent texture-streaming state.

fullResolutionResidencyRule.mipmapLimitGroupRule: A renderer-bound mipmapped Texture2D may not participate in a mipmap-limit group unless ignoreMipmapLimit=true. Formal 100% crops must not inherit a group-level down-resolution policy.
fullResolutionResidencyRule.reason: Unity 6 can omit highest-resolution texture mips through global or group limits while Texture2D width/height still report the original dimensions. Streaming textures can also change resident mip levels from camera state. Both can silently change native 4K microdetail without changing material bindings.

pipelineRule.reason: Realtime ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe and formal Camera.Render must use one rendering pipeline. Switching pipeline or Built-in tier settings between probe request and still capture invalidates reflection/material evidence.

fingerprintPayload: current/default/quality-override render-pipeline asset identity and dependency hash

ordered active renderer/material/property Texture2D bindings with dimensions, mip count, ignoreMipmapLimit, mipmapLimitGroup, requested mip level, asset GUID/dependency hash and importer streaming state
failureInjection: Set QualitySettings.globalTextureMipmapLimit to 1 after realtime reflection request; the next observed reflection poll must fail rather than accepting half-resolution texture evidence.
Enable streamingMipmaps on one renderer-bound texture; source validation must fail before formal capture.
Assign a mipmap-limit group to one renderer-bound texture without ignoreMipmapLimit; source validation must fail.
Change the active quality level or Built-in graphics-tier settings after reflection request; the fingerprint must change and invalidate the evidence epoch.
Assign an SRP asset through GraphicsSettings or the quality-level override; formal render-policy validation must fail before reflection/still evidence is accepted.
runtimeVerificationPending: temporal inspection for mip transition shimmer or residency changes
